rules:
; replaces the Nov 25 book, kept as data/book-v1-2026-11-25.json):
  The paper book is a frozen copy of Record › Top-20 book, so the Brief, Companies filters, What's next highlights and the
  tracked book are one list. NAV $250M. 15 longs + 5 shorts ranked on the conviction score plus a tilt for the next catalyst.
  Weight = base (longs 5%, shorts 3% of NAV) x conviction (score / median pick, 0.6-1.6) x catalyst skew (0.8-1.3) x vol
  scaler (0.6-1.4), capped at 8% / 5% of NAV, 10 days of 20% ADV and 4.9% of the company; names that cannot reach 1% of NAV
  are skipped. Long-biased by design (no XBI hedge); P&L is shown against XBI and the average covered stock.
  Entry = latest close in the price cache. No costs, borrow or dividends.

positions.why: Long: verekitug cut asthma exacerbations 56% vs placebo (p<0.001) with dosing every 12 weeks, and the company trades well below its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: Upstream Bio, Inc.

positions.why: Long: the company trades below its net cash after the $205M PRV sale, with ZYCUBO approved in Menkes disease.
positions.name: Fortress Biotech, Inc.

positions.why: $287M cap vs $270M prob-adj (W/AP=0.94x); Vafseo Q1 2026 patients +60% QoQ shows real ramp; Auryxia decline is the offset.
positions.name: Akebia Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long: CARDAMYST is approved for PSVT (64% vs 31% conversion) and cash of {cash} roughly matches debt, against a {cap} cap.
positions.name: Milestone Pharmaceuticals Inc.

positions.why: Prob-adj ~$108M (POS 90% × $120M W). LOQTORZI approved but niche ~3,000-pt NPC market caps revenue; CHS-114 pipeline optionality unproven pending mid-2026 data — override to AVOID pending pipeline readout.
positions.name: Coherus Oncology, Inc.

positions.why: Long into the PDUFA: D-PLEX100 cut surgical-site infections 60% (p=0.0013) in Ph3.
positions.name: PolyPid Ltd.

positions.why: Long: CTx-1301 met its Ph3 endpoints and its CRL was manufacturing only, against a {cap} cap.
positions.name: Cingulate Inc.

positions.why: Long: AD109 could be the first oral drug for obstructive sleep apnea; two Ph3s cut AHI 55.6% vs 19.1% (SynAIRgy) and 46.8% vs 6.8% (LunAIRo), with a PDUFA on Feb 28 2027.
positions.name: Apnimed, Inc.

positions.why: BYSANTI launch on track for Q3 2026 but undifferentiated vs generics; MDD adjunctive data guidance slipped to Q1 2027 from 'end of 2026,' and registry's Mar 2028 primary-completion date suggests further slip risk not yet priced in.
positions.name: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc.

positions.why: Long: miv-cel is the first CAR-T with a significant registrational result in stiff-person syndrome (49% median walking-speed gain, 92% off immunotherapy at one year).
positions.name: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long: sonelokimab showed 67-69% HiSCR75 at week 52 in hidradenitis suppurativa (VELA-1/2), against ~50% for bimekizumab, and the HS BLA went in on Sep 30.
positions.name: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics

positions.why: Long: cytisinicline's June CRL was manufacturing and labeling only. The clinical package is intact: ORCA-2 abstinence 32.6% vs 7.0% at weeks 9-12, and 31.2% quit at one year.
positions.name: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc.

positions.why: Long as cash value: VIZZ beat VUITY on near-vision response but sold only $2.6M in Q3; the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: LENZ Therapeutics, Inc.

toc.e: Sura-vec wet AMD pivotal topline Q4 2026

positions.why: Long: RGX-202 met its Duchenne pivotal endpoint, with 93% of patients above 10% micro-dystrophin (p<0.0001) and functional gains; BLA due Q1 2027.
positions.name: REGENXBIO Inc.

positions.why: Long: ACR-368 shows 39% responses in biomarker-positive endometrial cancer and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Strong short: lacutamab roughly matches mogamulizumab in Sézary syndrome (ORR 43% vs 37%), a small market, and cash is {cash}.
positions.name: Innate Pharma S.A.

positions.why: Strong short: the cell-therapy pipeline is preclinical with no IND, and cash is {cash}.
positions.name: SL Science Holding Limited

positions.why: Strong short: CXU is a device with no 510(k) filed and cash of {cash}.
positions.name: Conexeu Sciences Inc.

positions.why: Strong short: Armata carries $222M of debt against {cash} of cash, so equity has little backing even if the phage Ph3 succeeds.
positions.name: Armata Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

positions.why: Strong short: the US pivotal trial of MCS-2 failed, the NDA is guided to 2029-2030, and cash is {cash}.
positions.name: Jyong Biotech Ltd.
